Use unknown/insufficient when primary role cannot be settled. Supported means direct contract/code witness; limited means incomplete role support. This is not provider probability. state.query: Find how a subject write authorization is decoded into its typed representation.

source.code:
def parse_write_authorization(value: object) -> SubjectWriteAuthorization:
    data = _object(
        value,
        {
            "schema_version",
            "artifact_kind",
            "request_sha256",
            "decision_ref",
            "reviewer",
            "reviewer_authority",
            "recorded_at",
            "transition_refs",
        },
    )
    _version(data, "subject_source_write_authorization")
    return SubjectWriteAuthorization(
        data["request_sha256"],
        data["decision_ref"],
        data["reviewer"],
        data["reviewer_authority"],
        data["recorded_at"],
        tuple(_list(data["transition_refs"])),
    )
